observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage at a street dance competition, judges and audience watching in the background
observation.formation_and_space: solo performance moving around the center stage
observation.posture: upright torso, knees bent flexibly, weight shifting dynamically
observation.footwork: stepping, weight shifts, kicks, and turns in high-heeled shoes, matching the beats
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive arm movements, fast framing around the face, rotations, and extensions
observation.hips_and_torso: fluid hip sways, torso rolls, and isolation drops
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing turns, low level crouching and floor touch, standing posture
observation.costume_and_props: black sleeveless bodysuit with shorts and heeled shoes
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details are partially obscured by footwear and camera angle

rapid extension of arms with sharp stops and hip articulation
drop down to a low level with a sweeping arm rotation
continuous fluid arm waacking rotations combined with sharp foot pivots
quick drop to a knee and rising back up with high arms
